messages:
deploybot: Release candidate rc4 blocked by security gate: SBOM signature missing and vuln score above threshold.

sylvia: I just ran the CI build; SBOM was uploaded but signature step failed in pipeline.

kevin: @sylvia can you paste the cosign output? we need to know if it was a transient network issue or a KMS problem.

sylvia: cosign report: signing OK; attach to SBOM store failed with kms: key not found.

infra-oncall: we rotated secrets earlier. checking KMS bindings for pipeline-agent. ETA 5m.

release-manager: options: 1) re-run sign and push (15-30m), 2) scoped regional rollout with legal exception, 3) fallback to pinned build sha256:cafebabe. Need decision.

security-eng: vuln scan flagged one low-severity transitive lib, pushes score above 4.0. No exploitability seen. If we do a scoped rollout, require documented mitigations and follow-up ticket.

legal-bot: scoped rollout allowed only with named approver and expiry. Document customer impact and mitigation.

kevin: my plan: attempt automated re-sign now; if attach fails within 20m, switch to scoped eu rollout and get legal ack.

sylvia: starting re-sign: running script repush-sbom.sh rc4.

deploybot: job rb-9901 started.

deploybot: rb-9901 step cosign attach -> error kms: key not found.

infra-oncall: confirmed: role binding missing signing-role after rotation. rolling back binding.

deploybot: rb-9901 retry -> success. sbom signature attached: sbom-sig:sha256:abc123

kevin: re-running vuln scan.

deploybot: vuln job vs-5512 complete. VULN_SCORE=3.0 (now below threshold).

security-eng: scan delta verified. low severity only, score drop consistent with re-scan.

release-manager: gates cleared. anyone object to releasing as scheduled?

legal-bot: no objection, recording evidence: job_ids [rb-9901, vs-5512], sbom-sig sha256:abc123, incident IR-2026-03-21-kms-rot. Update release notes with provenance entry.

kevin: adding provenance line to release notes: cosign sig sha256:abc123, signed-by: pipeline-agent, KMS-incident: IR-2026-03-21-kms-rot.

infra-oncall: traffic tags and abort route ready. will monitor metrics during change window.

release-manager: rolling out to global. abort rules in place: latency > 3x or error rate spike > 0.5%.

security-eng: filing follow-up tickets: add pre-sign KMS role check and patch transitive lib.

deploybot: release unblocked -> rollout started at 2026-03-21T15:30:00Z
